targets.rawSql: SELECT inserted_at AS "time", value, pipeline_id AS metric FROM cicd_metrics WHERE metric_type = 'DEPLOYMENT_FREQUENCY' AND $__timeFilter(inserted_at) ORDER BY inserted_at
SELECT inserted_at AS "time", value, pipeline_id AS metric FROM cicd_metrics WHERE metric_type = 'LEAD_TIME_FOR_CHANGES' AND $__timeFilter(inserted_at) ORDER BY inserted_at
SELECT inserted_at AS "time", value, pipeline_id AS metric FROM cicd_metrics WHERE metric_type = 'CHANGE_FAILURE_RATE' AND $__timeFilter(inserted_at) ORDER BY inserted_at
SELECT inserted_at AS "time", value, pipeline_id AS metric FROM cicd_metrics WHERE metric_type = 'MEAN_TIME_TO_RECOVERY' AND $__timeFilter(inserted_at) ORDER BY inserted_at
SELECT inserted_at AS "time", value, pipeline_id AS metric FROM cicd_metrics WHERE metric_type = 'PIPELINE_HEALTH_SCORE' AND $__timeFilter(inserted_at) ORDER BY inserted_at

SELECT DISTINCT ON (metric_type, pipeline_id) inserted_at AS "time", metric_type, pipeline_id, service_name, value, performance_band FROM cicd_metrics ORDER BY metric_type, pipeline_id, inserted_at DESC

SELECT to_timestamp(window_start_ms / 1000) AS window_start, to_timestamp(window_end_ms / 1000) AS window_end, pipeline_id, service_name, value AS deploys_per_day, sample_count AS deploy_count, inserted_at AS computed_at FROM cicd_metrics WHERE metric_type = 'DEPLOYMENT_FREQUENCY' ORDER BY window_end_ms DESC LIMIT 20

panels.title: Truly-Late Events — Audit (per metric, per window)

targets.rawSql: SELECT to_timestamp(window_start_ms / 1000) AS window_start, to_timestamp(window_end_ms / 1000) AS window_end, metric_type AS source_metric, pipeline_id, service_name, value AS late_event_count, inserted_at AS computed_at FROM cicd_metrics WHERE metric_type IN ('DEPLOYMENT_FREQUENCY_LATE_EVENTS', 'CHANGE_FAILURE_RATE_LATE_EVENTS', 'PIPELINE_HEALTH_SCORE_LATE_EVENTS') ORDER BY window_end_ms DESC LIMIT 20
